title: The Debt of the Green Zone Anew
author: Petra Kavanagh
blurb: Gideon Quintana, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
